text.14:34: And He giveth you of all ye ask of Him, and if ye would count the bounty of Allah ye cannot reckon it. Lo! man is verily a wrong-doer, an ingrate.
text.16:18: And if ye would count the favour of Allah ye cannot reckon it. Lo! Allah is indeed Forgiving, Merciful.
text.19:84: So make no haste against them (O Muhammad). We do but number unto them a sum (of days).
text.19:94: Verily He knoweth them and numbereth them with (right) numbering.
text.22:47: And they will bid thee hasten on the Doom, and Allah faileth not His promise, but lo! a Day with Allah is as a thousand years of what ye reckon.
text.32:5: He directeth the ordinance from the heaven unto the earth; then it ascendeth unto Him in a Day, whereof the measure is a thousand years of that ye reckon.
text.38:62: And they say: What aileth us that we behold not men whom we were wont to count among the wicked?
